outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: None relevant here—there is no minor formatting/labeling issue to overlook because the required substantive information was never produced.

Critical issues: (1) Missing primary deliverable: the agent did not identify any currently playing film title, did not provide a film description, and did not provide any showtimes. (2) The agent’s final output is only a timeout error, which gives the user no actionable result for the requested task. (3) While screenshots show the agent reached DMNS “Films & Shows / Now Showing” context and a ticketing interface with “Sturm Theater” selected, none of the screenshots show any actual film listing, film details, or showtimes; the agent also did not report a clearly evidenced site blocker that explains inability to retrieve this info beyond the generic timeout message.

Outcome assessment: From an average user perspective, the task was not completed. The user needed a specific currently playing film and its showtimes; instead, the session ended with a connection timeout and no film information. The agent did respect constraints (no sign-in/purchase/seat reservation), but that does not satisfy the task’s goal because it never delivered the film title/description/showtimes.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use the Denver Museum of Nature & Science (dmns.org) website to find ONE film that is currently playing at the Sturm Infinity Theater, and then report that film’s title, what it’s about (a brief description), and its scheduled showtimes. A reasonable user would be flexible about the exact navigation path, but not flexible about missing the core deliverables (a real currently-playing film title + description + showtimes) or substituting unverified information.
